fanGetter.provenance: Existing exact RZ09-0528 fan query admission and FanRpmProtocol; returned byte times 100 RPM

workload: None; all builds and other task activity must be quiescent
durationScope: Observation duration only; activation, confirmation and guarded restoration add to total mode 7 residence. Late completion beyond tolerance fails validation but permits fresh known-state cleanup.
abortPolicy: Freeze each active sensor at min(baseline median + 10 C, 60 C); stop at or above threshold. Experimental tripwire, not a hardware thermal rating or proof of safety.
inactiveGpuPolicy: Explicitly inactive throughout baseline may remain inactive; unexpected activation aborts because no active-temperature baseline exists
fanPolicy: Both valid RPM readbacks required; no invented minimum RPM or copied cooling-pad criterion
gpuOffsets: Both zero, independently confirmed; no GPU writes
coolingPad: Robust absent samples and continued absence; reconnect aborts dwell but does not prevent known-state restoration
ordinaryAbort: End observation, then freshly confirm exact mode 7, full AC, GPU zero, identity and controller isolation before one Performance restoration pair
ambiguousHidOrThermalPair: No further writes; read-only reconciliation and manual recovery
claims: One bounded developer no-load observation only; no load/stress, lifecycle, performance or production padless readiness
